_comment: "Discard an ALLY, destroy this: Draw a card." The ally requirement was a `filter` list the cost does not read, holding CARD_IN_ZONE -- a condition that COUNTS cards in a zone rather than testing one candidate, so it could not have worked as a filter either. With no filter the cost discarded a RANDOM card and, worse, can_pay returned true whenever the hand was non-empty: the ability was activatable with no ally at all. Costs must block legality. 'Ally' is matched as a type, which is what the shared hand filter reads.
